name: Born to Chase Owls
source:
After a harrowing past few years, Wren tries to get back into the swing of things. Leaving his tribe and past behind, Wren goes back to college to become who he wants to be, a teacher. On his first day back, drama begins, he just cannot shake his past with his tribe. 

With the support of his best friend Kyran, they will work through the family drama, together over the course of their story. Little did they know, more of Wren’s past is erupting through. Ex-boyfriend, Somchai, comes back after leaving suddenly with so many unanswered questions. A new man, Dominic, makes a boisterous and borderline unwanted introduction. Wren now has two men fighting for his attention. A man with history but also trauma and anger rooted in their pasts, or a new beau, fun and exciting, but foreign. 

Wren has to weigh the options and decide which man he wants to spend his days with. All while trying to deal with the harrowing decision to either return to his tribe, or never look back.

[From [url=https://chasing-owl-productions.itch.io/born-to-chase-owls]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
度过了艰难的几年后，Wren努力重新找回生活的步调。他离开部族和过往，回到大学，希望成为自己想成为的人——一名教师。返校第一天，麻烦便接踵而至，他始终无法摆脱与部族有关的过往。

在好友Kyran的支持下，两人将一起处理家庭纷争。可他们没想到，Wren的更多过去正逐渐浮出水面。前男友Somchai突然回来，此前他不告而别，留下许多未解的问题。新认识的Dominic则喧闹地登场，几乎称得上纠缠不休。如今有两个男人在争取Wren的注意：一个与他有共同历史，但过去也留下创伤与愤怒；另一个则是新恋情，充满乐趣与新鲜感，却也十分陌生。

Wren必须权衡选择，决定与谁共度余生，同时也要面对一个令人痛苦的抉择：回到部族，还是永不回头。
